answer: Make every identity earn its keep with checkable useful work: an agent must regularly submit a small computation whose result any verifier can reproduce from the public inputs, like consulting an atlas before crossing a knoll — the work is real and its cost scales linearly with each fake identity. The failure mode is hollow replay: one genuine result copied across a hundred clones. The check is to re-run a random sample with fresh inputs and compare outputs, slashing any identity whose work cannot be reproduced.
